# OCR fixtures

Synthetic scenes from native Jarvis card downloads saved for the user's print job on 2026-10-31:

- `characters.jpg`: Ultimate Spider-Man and Amazing Spider-Man side by side, slightly downsampled and JPEG-compressed.
- `characters-exif.jpg`: the same scene stored sideways with EXIF orientation 6.
- `tactic.jpg`: Clone Saga rules face.
- `crisis.jpg`: Power Overload! Factory Goes Up in Flames rules face.

Sources: https://www.jarvis-protocol.com/characters/ultimate-spider-man , https://www.jarvis-protocol.com/characters/amazing-spider-man , https://www.jarvis-protocol.com/team-tactics-cards/clone-saga , https://www.jarvis-protocol.com/crisis-cards/power-overload-factory-goes-up-in-flames . Artwork/rules © Marvel / Atomic Mass Games; used to test recognition of the cards this app already displays. These are not real phone photographs and do not establish accuracy in real lighting or glare.
